newsitem.title: USA: Telco hopes to be profitable through FY97.
newsitem.headline: Telco hopes to be profitable through FY97.

text.p: Telco Systems Inc, which earlier Wednesday reported record sales and a return to profitability for its fiscal fourth quarter ended August 25, "plans" to remain profitable through fiscal 1997, subject to new development and sales expansion investments.

It reported record fourth-quarter sales of $29.6 million, up from $19.3 million a year ago. Net income was $1.2 million or $0.11 per share, compared with a loss of $1.2 million or $0.12) per share last year. The latest quarter included a one-time gain of $0.04 per share which was an adjustment to restructuring charges recorded in the third quarter.

"We are very pleased with the progress we made in the last two quarters. The turn around in fourth quarter results reflects the success of a restructured management organization and a team effort companywide to return Telco Systems to profitable growth," said Dr. Will Smith, president and chief executive officer.

New orders in the fourth quarter rose to a record level of $35.5 million, exceeding an earlier record of $33.2 million in the most recent third quarter. The fourth quarter included the early receipt of some customer stocking orders and reflected increased customer demand for both broadband products and the Access60r network access server.

"While the company's plan calls for maintaining quarterly profitability throughout fiscal 1997, results will reflect continuing investments in new product development and in expansion of sales and marketing activities," added Smith.
